item.case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
item.title: Fox Logo Throughout the Clip

turns.text: Put this fox in the top-right corner as a small logo for the whole video. Remove its white background, leave a little space around it, and keep the video and sound otherwise unchanged.

item.tests: Tests persistent corner-logo compositing, clean background removal, and preservation of the source video and audio.

answer_sheet.Logo asset and treatment: Use mascot-fox.png, removing the white background without removing parts of the fox.
answer_sheet.Logo position, size, and timing: Top-right corner with a small inset, visible throughout all 10 seconds; small enough not to cover the woman's face.
answer_sheet.Video framing and sound: Keep the source aspect ratio, framing, timing, and original speech. No new music or text.

must_haves: The video shows the same woman at the kitchen table, with the source framing and sequence preserved.
The supplied orange-hoodie fox appears in the top-right corner from the first frame through the last frame.
The fox has no visible white rectangular background and is not clipped at the frame edges.
The logo remains small and does not obscure the woman's face.
The original speech remains audible and synchronized throughout the 10-second clip.

turns.text: Put this fox in the top-right corner as a small logo for the whole video. Remove its white background, leave a little space around it, and keep the video and sound otherwise unchanged.

dialog.agent:
This needs a **fixed logo overlay**, but the connected tools don’t support compositing a logo onto a video. Using the AI video editor could change the footage, so it wouldn’t meet your “otherwise unchanged” requirement.

I can remove the fox’s white background to prepare a transparent PNG. To finish in a video editor, place it in the **top-right**, about **10% of the video’s width**, with a **2–3% margin**, extend it for the full duration, and leave the original audio untouched.

Would you like me to prepare the transparent fox PNG?
dialog.why: It asks whether the user wants a transparent fox PNG prepared and waits for their choice.

turns.agent:
The background removal was blocked because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. It costs **5 credits**, and no file was created.

Once you have enough credits, I can try again.
